rows.title: If a task is renamed in another tab or on another device while its text box is open, clicking away without typing puts the old text back over the newer one
rows.summary: Now: TodoItem (src/components/job/TodoItem.jsx) remembers the text its box opened with (an `opened` ref set on double-click, as job/Field.jsx does since R5-JOB-07). commit() renames only when the trimmed draft differs from that text and from the task's current text, so a box left untouched writes nothing on blur or Enter, and another tab's or a sync's newer rename stays. A real edit is still saved. docs/knowledge/07-job-tracker.md notes the behaviour.

rows.title: An imported job's day written month-first ('Oct 15, 2026') or as 'YYYY/MM/DD' / '2026-1-5' is left as text, and the Summary lists even a passed one under 'Upcoming deadlines'
rows.summary: Now: jobDay (src/utils/normalizeJob.js, which completeJob runs on every import, load and cloud copy) also reads 'Oct 15, 2026', 'October 15 2026', 'Sept. 1, 2026', '2026/10/15', '2026/1/5' and '2026-1-5' as 'YYYY-MM-DD'. It checks them through parseDayDate, so an impossible day like 'Feb 31, 2026' or '2026/13/01' stays as written, and so does an ambiguous '10/15/2026'. So the card shows its deadline pill, a passed follow-up counts as due, the List sorts these jobs by date, and the Overview's pickers show the day. The Summary's 'Upcoming deadlines' now uses isDeadlineUpcoming (src/utils/jobQuery.js), which takes only an open job's 'YYYY-MM-DD' deadline of today or later. A deadline it cannot compare is left out and no longer compared as text. docs/knowledge/07-job-tracker.md describes it.

review.notes: Reviewed 767ba30e and e49ef401 against origin/claude/r4-green (185192d7). Fail-first logs checked: 767ba30e fails 2 tests without its diff and passes with it; e49ef401 fails 3 without and passes with it (run 36646826369); area tests and lint green (36646831850). TodoItem: the opened-text ref fixes the root cause (commit compared the draft only with the current text), matches job/Field.jsx (R5-JOB-07), a real edit still saves, and Escape still resets; todo text is always a string after readJob, so .trim() is safe. jobDay: month-first and YYYY/M/D forms are rewritten into forms parseDayDate already validates, so impossible days (Feb 31, month 13) and ambiguous 10/15/2026 stay as written; completeJob runs on load, import (jobMerge) and cloud copies (useCollectionSync), and the same normalisation path already existed for "15 Jan 2026" (R5-HUNT5), so no new sync churn. isDeadlineUpcoming keeps the Summary list to ISO days, so the localeCompare sort only compares ISO days. Other deadline readers (ListView, KanbanView, OverviewTab, JobDetail via DatePill/deadlineState) are unchanged and get ISO days now. Not in scope: interview dates are not normalised by jobDay (existing behaviour, not caused by this fix). Second pass (independent re-review at 0887e554): re-read both diffs and the fail-first job logs (109671658350: 767ba30e '# fail 2' with its diff reversed, passes with it; 109671658420: e49ef401 '# fail 3', passes with it); run 36646831850 concluded success. TasksTab keys each TodoItem by todo.id, so the opened-text ref belongs to one task; a to-do's text is always a string after readJob (readableTodo), so opened.current.trim() cannot throw. The month-first regex only rewrites a word that MONTH_OF knows ('Due 15, 2026' stays as written); no other code compares deadline or followUpDate as text (grep). Only side effect: a stored task text with surrounding spaces is no longer re-saved trimmed when its box is closed untouched, which is harmless. No defect found.
